outputs: Original current papers and bibliographic records

outputs: Teacher understanding, limitations and questions

steps.what: Talk with colleagues about developments in agricultural sciences and reconcile differing interpretations of the actual evidence.
inputs: Actual papers and questions from s2
outputs: Actual discussion and clarified or unresolved interpretations

steps.what: Participate in actual professional conferences, including disciplinary sessions, questions and exchange with agricultural researchers and practitioners.
outputs: Actual participation and learning

tasks.design: Configure native subject/publication alerts in the authorised library service. The teacher reads originals, talks with colleagues, actually participates in conferences and records actual insights.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual repeated navigation of relevant scholarly sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue and scholarly subject alerts.
tasks.still_hard: Transferability of agricultural findings across crops, soils, climates and study designs.

ambition.what: No automatic teaching change or research conclusion.

evidence.claim: Native scholarly subject alerts can reduce repeated catalogue navigation without replacing scientific appraisal.

assumptions: Shares are E1 conditional active-work estimates rather than measured baselines. Actual reading, colleague exchange, conference participation and an existing personal working note are included. Conference registration, travel purchase and institutional training reporting are not invented as routine components.

Publishers supply existing bibliographic records and original papers through unchanged publication work. The teacher obtains original sources in s1 and produces actual interpretation and notes in s2-s5. Missing references are resolved manually; no invented citations or automatic summary substitutes.

Native alerts come first. Already configured alerts produce zero new saving. No gain on substantive reading, conversation, conference time, actual note content or save runtime. The ordinary completed-note check provides the requested gate without extra self-approval labour; edits require rechecking. Learning or attendance is never inferred from the calendar.
research_questions: Do subject alerts reduce repeat navigation while keeping relevant original papers accessible?

already_counted.description: Original reading, scholarly exchange, actual conference participation, factual notes and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Review subject alert relevance and source access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed scholarly note checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.40=6 gross; less 1 alert upkeep gives 5. Zero if alerts already remove the navigation.

tasks.short: Supervise agricultural lab and field operations

steps.what: Establish actual laboratory-session and field-work needs with technicians, students and facility owners, including real room, plot, equipment and staffing availability.
inputs: Actual availability and constraints from responsible people
outputs: Actual operation requirements and available resource windows

steps.what: Capture and check actual session times, plots, rooms, equipment and responsible people in the existing shared lab-operations planning sheet {SPREADSHEET}.
inputs: Actual requirements and availability from s1
outputs: Actual checked planning rows

steps.what: Compare actual laboratory and field-work planning rows for exact time overlaps on the same room, plot or uniquely identified equipment in {SPREADSHEET}.
outputs: Draft exact-resource overlap flags

steps.what: Resolve actual resource conflicts and check the final laboratory and field-operation plan against readiness, staffing and existing safety requirements.
outputs: Checked final operations plan and recipients

steps.what: Save the exact checked final operations plan in {SPREADSHEET}.
outputs: Saved final operations plan

steps.what: Send the exact checked laboratory and field-operation plan to the responsible internal participants through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Unchanged final plan saved in s5
outputs: Actual delivered operations plan

steps.what: Supervise actual laboratory sessions and field work, checking real readiness and adapting guidance to students, specimens, equipment and field conditions under existing controls.
inputs: Existing authorised procedures and readiness checks
outputs: Actual supervised work, observations and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write and check actual completed-session observations, equipment issues and necessary follow-up in the existing lab-operations log {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual session and field observations from s7
outputs: Checked actual operations-log draft

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual session log in the lab-operations system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact actual log checked in s8
outputs: Saved actual session log

tasks.design: Use native spreadsheet overlap rules for actual room, plot and equipment rows. Retain actual constraint collection, conflict resolution, physical readiness and direct lab/field supervision. Planning saves and sends precede actual work; the real post-session log is separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: A remaining manual exact-resource overlap check in an existing planning sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spreadsheet comparisons on captured times and resource identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Actual readiness, agricultural field conditions and student practical work.
tasks.human_edge: Observe real work and intervene appropriately under existing controls.

ambition.what: No autonomous lab operation or safety authorisation.

tasks.altitude: A small planning check improves while physical supervision remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Use actual resource identifiers without treating no overlap as readiness

evidence.claim: Native spreadsheet rules can identify exact-resource time overlaps without deciding laboratory or field readiness.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured lab baselines. Coordination includes its actual planning rows, final plan delivery and real post-session log, separated from physical supervision.

The teacher obtains real resource constraints in s1 and captures them in s2. Technician and facility-owner inputs are their existing unchanged work, not a new free reporting feed. Missing times or resource identifiers require manual resolution; no guessed availability or inferred completion.

Native sheet rules replace only an actual remaining manual exact-overlap check. If already present, new saving is zero. No automatic prioritisation, readiness decision or inference that no conflict means safe work. Existing physical safety checks remain fully in s7.

Ordinary completed-plan and log checks supply requested gates without added self-approval labour. Plan changes require renewed final checking before save/send. Actual log content follows real work, never a calendar end time. Short saves and sends receive no saving.
research_questions: Does the rule flag known overlaps and missing fields while leaving readiness and conflict resolution to the responsible people?

already_counted.description: Actual constraint collection/capture, resolution, plan delivery, physical supervision and factual log remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain and test exact-resource overlap rules.

Unchanged plan and recipients checked in s4
Exact actual session log checked in s8
